scope: Shared same-user EOF-framed control I/O used by native Linux and macOS helpers; 5-second absolute transfer deadlines, 1 MiB messages, eight concurrent accepted clients per native control server.

cases: Slow byte delivery cannot extend absolute request deadline
Non-reading client cannot indefinitely hold response writer

implementationEvidence: An initial backpressure test hung in __sendto with only MSG_DONTWAIT; explicit descriptor O_NONBLOCK fixes that observed failure.
limitations: Tests use real local socket pairs, not physical VM lifecycle campaigns.
Peer rejection from another OS user and eight-client admission have not been exercised by these tests.
Command execution deadlines, inode-safe listener cleanup and full operation/generation binding remain open.
